items.title: Four equivalent formulations of the J-2 property for a locally Noetherian scheme, and the transfer to schemes locally of finite type over it
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma states four equivalent formulations of the J-2 property for a locally Noetherian scheme and adds that every scheme locally of finite type over such a scheme is J-2 (statement lines 3309-3323). The counted proof is a 30-line argument with real content: the transfer statement is derived from stability of locally finite type morphisms under open immersion and composition, the implications (1) to (3) and (2) to (4) are then formal because the conditions are local on an open covering, and the only substantial direction, (4) implies (1), is proved by covering a scheme locally of finite type over X by affine opens V_j mapping into the affines U_i of the assumed covering, converting local finiteness of type into finiteness of type of the ring maps O(U_i) to O(V_j), and concluding openness of the regular locus from the equality of Reg(Y) intersect V_j with Reg(V_j) (proof lines 3326-3353). It is H2 under the lane rule for short proofs: the proof contains a checkable reduction and a genuine local-to-global step rather than a restatement, and the one definitional citation it makes (at proof line 3337) cites the definition of a J-2 ring, not an omitted argument.
